decisions.reason: Restores 눈빛 as the astonishment in Cheongpung’s eyes and tightens 희미하게 웃어 보였다 to a faint smile.
한 대씩 is one blow each, not a full beating; “got a good whack in on every last” keeps that limit.
Echoes the whack wording and the clipped 다 때리긴 누가 denial instead of restating “beat up.”
Keeps the sudden rebranding as a hidebound old man while dropping the 몸을 trembled calque.
하나뿐인 지기 is “one and only kindred spirit,” which BASE under-renders as “one.”
눈물을 머금고 is tears in the eyes; SOL’s “holding back” adds unstated restraint.
Restores the 모르긴 몰라도 hedge that BASE omitted.
“Came flooding in” matches 밀려 들어온, and “telling” matches 의미심장한 better than generic “meaningful.”
Restores the 산 채로 통구이 whole-roast image that BASE flattened to “roasted alive.”
Keeps 아니기는 as “Like hell you’re not” and the full 속이느니 차라리 comparison to fooling a ghost.
“Kill-or-be-killed” is the natural rendering of 죽고 죽이는 without BASE’s locked-in padding.
Preserves the 않았다면 말이다 hinge as “until he opened his mouth again a moment later.”
P170’s content moved into the H012 sentence; keeping the standalone line would duplicate the beat.
중진들 are the family’s senior members, not glossary Elders (장로).
BASE adds “unfortunately”; SOL drops the trailing 그만. An ellipsis keeps the cutoff.
언뜻 is a brief flash of anger, not merely a trace.
BASE doubles “out of here”; SOL weakens 빨리 튀자 to “I’m gone.”
decisions.replacement: *Enough. The moment I get out of here, I’m getting the hell out. Maybe I should just use Logout altogether.*
